wa_2025.validation_method: like-for-like: NISAR new-flood mask vs OPERA DSWx-S1 new flood (water on 2025-12-15/17 AND NOT water 2025-12-01..07), cloud-free on both dates; NISAR swath ~ AOI
wa_2025.validation_method_raw: all water: NISAR flood mask vs every OPERA DSWx-S1 water pixel 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI (includes permanent/pre-existing water, so FN is inflated)
wa_2025.hls_method: all water, OPERA DSWx-HLS (optical) 2025-12-15/17, cloud-free pixels only; 92.9% cloud -> reference mostly unobserved; not comparable to iou/f1
wa_2025.cloud_pct_source: OPERA DSWx-HLS cloud class (WTR 253) 2025-12-15/17 over the AOI

forecast_lead_time.skipped_reason: no SMAP S for D-1 (series starts at the window start)
forecast_lead_time.alignment: L28b: issue D 00Z; observed IMERG days <= D-1 only; GFS D 00Z run calendar days D..D+3; frame D+k = 3-day sum ending D+k
forecast_lead_time.basis: GFS-forecast replay TPI: R_fc = score(3-day sum ending D+k: obs IMERG days <= D-1 + GFS days D..D+k) vs case climatology, S held at D-1, T static; critical = AOI max over slide/flood > 0.6 for depicted date <= anchor
forecast_lead_time.denominator_note: quote n_warned of n_eligible_issue_days; issue days after the anchor cannot warn by definition

wa_2025.opera_fn_diagnosis: raw FN 1.19M px = permanent/pre-existing water (pre_water 1.21M px) which our new-flood mask correctly excludes; like-for-like FN drops to 60.7k px

landslide_hit.definition: share of inventory points with TPI_slide >= 0.6 (Critical)
landslide_hit.note: WGS inventory points are undated; hit evaluated per day, headline on the case critical peak day (critical_km2_date). n = 15 is small.

flood_warned.definition: share of the NISAR-confirmed new-flood AREA (GCOV, post 2025-12-16) with TPI Alto or higher (>= 0.4; Crítico > 0.6) in the frames available 24-48 h before the anchor (max over window frames; observed = series bands dated anchor-2d..anchor-1d, latency ignored; forecast_gfs = L22 issued GFS 00Z runs 24-48 h before the anchor, frames depicting dates <= the anchor day); each damage location takes the ~90 m TPI cell that contains it
flood_warned.anchor_source: King County Flood Warning Center update (case damage anchor, data/wa_2025/lead_time_metrics.json)
flood_warned.explanation: TPI_flood is pixel-local: at the flooded pixels T_flood is high (HAND, mean ~0.96) but local 3-day rain stayed below the pixel's P90 (R = 0) and SMAP wetness low until the 2025-12-10 frame. The river flooding was driven by rain upstream in the Cascades, which a pixel-local R does not see; the index rose on the flooded valley floors only after the first damage report.

wa_2025.gpw_product: GPW v4.11 population count (CIESIN/NASA SEDAC), 30 arc-sec
wa_2025.population_total_scope: sum of the case GPW COG over the case AOI
wa_2025.scar_method: OPERA DIST-ALERT-HLS VEG-DIST-STATUS in {5,6,8} (>=50 % loss), first detection in window, slope > 15 deg (NASADEM via GEE T_slide 90 m), not cropland/water (MCD12Q1 2025), 3 px..1 km2; candidates, never confirmed

rs_2024.slide_warned_by_lead_definition: slide_warned_{gfs|observed}_{24|48|72}h[_critical]_pct = % of the 16,027 RS 2024 inventory landslide points whose ~90 m TPI_slide cell was Alto+ (>= 0.4) [Crítico > 0.6] in: gfs = the NOAA GFS 00Z run issued 24/48/72 h before 2024-05-01 00Z (max over its d1..d3 frames depicting dates <= 2024-05-01); observed = the observed TPI band dated 24/48/72 h before (rain ending that day 00Z, latency ignored). Points on TPI no-data stay in the denominator.
